### A Global Movement

Bringing forth change through innovative collaboration.

## Support Our Mission

We protect, publish, and preserve vulnerable plants — using copyleft, research,
and education. To date we are 100% crowdfunded and rely on people like you to
make this work possible.

[Donate Now](https://www.patreon.com/CopyleftCultivarsNonprofit){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
